def: Shemer, the name of three Israelites

occurrences.text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
